workflows.name: check-final-newline
workflows.title: Check final newline
workflows.description: Check that a nonempty text file ends with a newline. Empty files pass.
workflows.yaml:
description: "Check that a nonempty text file ends with a newline. Empty files pass."

inputs:
  path:
    type: string
    required: true

steps:
  - name: "Check final newline"
    shell: |
      python3 - {{shellQuote(path)}} <<'PYTHON'
      import os
      import sys

      with open(sys.argv[1], "rb") as source:
          if source.seek(0, os.SEEK_END):
              source.seek(-1, os.SEEK_END)
              if source.read(1) != b"\n":
                  sys.exit("The file is missing a final newline.")
      print("Final newline check passed")
      PYTHON

workflows.name: file-compare
workflows.title: Compare two text files
workflows.description: Show a unified diff between two local text files. Differences are a successful result.
workflows.yaml:
description: "Show a unified diff between two local text files. Differences are a successful result."

inputs:
  before:
    type: string
    required: true
  after:
    type: string
    required: true

steps:
  - name: "Compare two text files"
    shell: |
      set -eu
      before={{shellQuote(before)}}
      after={{shellQuote(after)}}
      [ "$before" != - ] || before=./-
      [ "$after" != - ] || after=./-
      status=0
      diff -u -- "$before" "$after" || status=$?
      if [ "$status" -gt 1 ]; then
        exit "$status"
      fi

workflows.name: project-setup
workflows.title: Project setup
workflows.description: Installs locked dependencies in the current project. Use a disposable checkout when trying this workflow. Run it from the root of a trusted project.
workflows.yaml:
description: Install locked project dependencies in the current directory
steps:
  - name: Install dependencies
    shell: |
      set -eu
      if [ ! -f composer.lock ] && [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'Expected composer.lock or package-lock.json in the project root.' >&2
        exit 2
      fi
      if [ -f composer.lock ]; then
        composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist
      fi
      if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
        npm ci --ignore-scripts
      fi

workflows.name: python-check-csv-columns
workflows.title: Check CSV column widths
workflows.description: Check that each CSV record has the same number of fields as the header.
workflows.yaml:
description: "Check that each CSV record has the same number of fields as the header."

inputs:
  path:
    type: string
    required: true

steps:
  - name: "Check CSV column widths"
    shell: |
      python3 - {{shellQuote(path)}} <<'PYTHON'
      import csv
      import sys

      with open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as source:
          rows = csv.reader(source, strict=True)
          header = next(rows, [])
          if not header:
              sys.exit("The CSV header is missing.")
          for row in rows:
              if len(row) != len(header):
                  sys.exit(f"Record ending at line {rows.line_num}: expected {len(header)} fields, found {len(row)}.")
      print(f"CSV records match the {len(header)} header fields.")
      PYTHON

steps:
  - name: "Check Python syntax"
    shell: |
      python3 - {{shellQuote(path)}} <<'PYTHON'
      import sys
      import tokenize

      path = sys.argv[1]
      with tokenize.open(path) as source:
          compile(source.read(), path, 'exec')
      print("Python syntax is valid")
      PYTHON
